name: Ray-Guided Culling
definition: A culling approach where the working set is grown dynamically during rendering by adding only bricks intersected by rays. It implicitly culls occluded bricks and bricks outside the view frustum (as no rays are generated outside the frustum).
summary: Ray-guided culling dynamically builds the GPU working set during rendering to load only intersected bricks, avoiding pre-computation and implicit occlusion culling.
